scope: Croatia medical discovery — University of Rijeka Faculty of Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: University of Rijeka's Faculty of Medicine describes Medical Studies in English as a full-time integrated university medicine programme of six years and 360 ECTS, awarding Doctor of Medicine (MD).

The official programme page identifies the Faculty as a public HEI delivering the programme under a Ministry license, with Croatian/English study language and regulated-profession status under Croatia's relevant Act and Directive 2005/36/EC.
Rijeka publishes 2026 local Medicine entry quotas, national-exam prerequisites and July/September enrolment dates, but this is not a complete English-track international admissions record.
